blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines–The Philippine men’s football team squandered a two-goal halftime lead before being held to a 2-2 draw by Pakistan in the Fifa Asean Cup on Tuesday at Si Jalak Harupat Stadium in Bandung, Indonesia. It looked like the Filipino side was on the verge of securing the maximum three points after Sandro Reyes scored the opener and striker Bjorn Kristensen added a second from the penalty area. But Ali Khan pulled one back for Pakistan shortly after the restart before Abdul Samad came through with an equalizer from a counterattack, enough to share the spoils with the Philippines.
